existing_structures: index.vue uses BasicTable with useListPage hook for CRUD
searchMode toggle (normal/smart) is located inside the Table toolbar slot
Smart search panel is placed outside and above BasicTable
Normal search form is automatically generated by BasicTable using searchFormSchema
scopeOptions for smart search is dynamically computed based on userStore.getUserInfo.roleCode
existing_conventions: Vue 3 <script setup> syntax with Composition API
Ant Design Vue UI components (a-radio-group, a-select, a-input, etc.)
JeecgBoot's useListPage hook to manage table state, fetching, and actions
constraints_discovered: Visual disconnect: Smart search panel is outside BasicTable, but its toggle is inside the table's toolbar.
Conflicting UI: Normal search form (from searchFormSchema) remains visible even when smart search mode is active.
Shared View: Teacher and student roles use the same index.vue; conditional logic is needed if permissions differ.
Data Handling Conflict: Normal mode uses server-side pagination via useListPage API, while Smart mode manually injects results using setTableData(), which may break table pagination if not disabled.
open_questions: Should the smart search inputs be injected into the BasicTable's form slot instead of floating above the table?
Should the '新增/批量删除/导入/导出' buttons be hidden for teachers if they are only viewing notes?
How should pagination be handled in Smart mode? semanticSearchNotes returns an array, so local pagination or hiding the paginator might be required.
risks: Pagination breaks: BasicTable might trigger getNoteList when page changes in Smart mode instead of paginating the semantic results.
Dynamic Form Hiding: Need proper API to hide BasicTable's built-in search form dynamically (e.g., setProps({ useSearchForm: false })).
success_criteria_hints: Normal search form disappears when Smart mode is activated.
Smart search panel appears seamlessly integrated with the table, not floating disconnected.
Pagination works correctly or is disabled in Smart mode.
Role-based visibility ensures Teachers see the 'Course Notes' option.
